name: agentic-z-panel
description: A side panel for Agentic-Z: DayZ status at a glance and one-click buttons for mount P:, build, the build and in game checks, deploy, launch, stop, Workbench, Object Builder, test logs, the health page and the release pack, and a field that asks /dayz-ask a vanilla question. The buttons run the skill scripts directly, so they cost no model tokens; the ask field uses a short model call to write its answer. Windows only.
